answer: To resist sybil attacks, an agent economy should require every identity to lock a burnable stake before it can earn. Each persona is forged from ferrous collateral that is destroyed if audit proves the account hollow, so cloning thousands is a losing bet. Every honest attestation leaves an ember on the public ledger that peers can replay to trace the identity's full history. Governance then counts one vote per established agent, making a fabricated fleet of quartz-cold puppets strategically worthless.
